name: trade-assistant
description: Trade Assistant chat: talk to the trade agent inside VS Code with the live trading MCP tools, plus capability and skill sync.

viewsWelcome.contents: Trade Assistant is loading capabilities from agents/trade.md, skills and mcp-config.json.

tradeAssistant.repoRoot.description: Absolute path to the opencode-skills repository. Empty value auto-detects the repository that contains this extension.

tradeAssistant.mcpConfigPath.description: Absolute path to mcp-config.json. Empty value uses ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json.

tradeAssistant.tradingServerName.description: Server name to read from mcpServers.

tradeAssistant.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for file watcher refresh.

tradeAssistant.chat.modelFamily.description: Copilot model family or id for the chat panel. Empty value selects the first available Copilot model automatically.

tradeAssistant.chat.maxToolIterations.description: Maximum tool-call rounds per chat turn. After the limit the model must answer with the results it already has.

tradeAssistant.chat.temperature.description: Sampling temperature sent to the chat model.

tradeAssistant.chat.provider.markdownDescription: Chat backend. `auto` uses OpenCode Go when a key exists in `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json`, otherwise GitHub Copilot models.

tradeAssistant.chat.model.description: OpenCode Go model id. Empty value reads the model from agents/trade.md frontmatter and strips the opencode-go/ prefix.

tradeAssistant.fileAccess.roots.description: Allowed roots for the file tools (read_file, list_dir, find_files, search_text). Empty value uses the workspace folders, the repository root and the home directory.
